name: Elder's Runes
source: Elder's Runes: A novel that tells the story of the MC, a boy who suffered from childhood due to his father’s abandonment and an even tougher adolescence. In his adult life, he discovers a way to travel between worlds, leading him to live crazy adventures with all sorts of beings while slowly uncovering his family’s history and the history of the universe itself.
